integrity: Proof and exact standard-library checker supplied; no independent mathematical audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Classification concerns one harmonic degree at a time on one fixed 15-line H3 configuration, not noisy stability, arbitrary sites, or spectral conditioning. Low ranks and 200 modular determinants are exactly reproducible; the infinite tail relies separately on Bernstein Legendre bounds. Uninspected icosahedral representation tables pose residual publication-priority risk.
title: Exact all-degree harmonic interpolation on fifteen icosidodecahedral root lines
